results.title: Who protects the dreamer? (Part II) — Reflections on the vulnerability of the Girl Child in the Obuasi Senior High Technical School Scandal
results.content: There is something sickeningly cruel about a society that encourages a girl to dream, sends her to school to build that dream, and then leaves her vulnerable to the very people entrusted with protecting her. The allegations emerging from Obuasi Senior High Technical School against its headmaster, Zakaria Abdulai, involving sexual abuse, including rape, are deeply disturbing. If established, these allegations would represent not merely a crime, but a monstrous betrayal of trust, authority and the sacred responsibility of educating children.

results.title: Healthy Eating on a Limited Budget: When there is simply not enough money for lunch
results.content: There are times when eating well becomes difficult for a very practical reason: the money is simply not there. You may leave home for work or school knowing that you cannot afford to buy lunch that day. Perhaps the money you have needs to last until the end of the week, or other pressing expenses—transportation, school fees, rent, medication, utilities or an unexpected bill—have had to come first. There may even be some food at home, but little or nothing left to spend on meals outside the home.
